about: The Petrov/Petroff opening is ONE lesson, 'Petroff (Russian) Defense', and a player's progress under the removed name 'Petrov (Russian) Defense' moves onto it. Gate 74 run with CT_74_GEOS=se (its own per-geometry blocks on the small phone only, to keep the run short); graded lines are TC-LS-049 (the rendered Openings list at kunal761 offers it once, by name, with the Petrov name gone from the library) and TC-LS-050 (ct_learnprog, ct_train, ct_lastlesson and the coach slate re-keyed from the removed names). The 049/050 block opens its own kunal761 browser whatever CT_74_GEOS says, so that is the one situation. NOT COVERED: TC-LS-052 (the cloud-sync index shift, a separate sync defect), the Sicilian/Ruy Lopez renames beyond the lines TC-LS-050 grades, and whether he agrees Petroff is the right name to keep (the orchestrator ruled it, 4 Nov 2026).
